policy: Handwritten synthetic diagnostics; not independent annotation or a held-out population benchmark. Explicit final corrective action determines the movement label. Informational and meta-language requests are none (not a movement instruction). No multi-action, vague prohibition or conditional commands. Labels frozen before inference. Six balanced labels, 16 each, 96 cases, disjoint from baseline18. Reuse the seven upstream prompt configurations without fitting or selection.
